title: Predicting patient-reported outcomes following lumbar spine surgery: development and external validation of multivariable prediction models.
summary: Prediction models for patient-reported outcomes after lumbar surgery used 4,307 patients and temporal external validation (development 2,691; validation 1,616). The result is limited to degenerative-pathology surgery and follow-up definitions.
